ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: -Bidder shall mandatorily submit all requisite documents in accordance with the Eligibilit y Criteria specified at Annexure-III. Non Submission or incomplete submission of any of the above documents shall render th e bid liable for rejection without any further correspondence or consideration. A. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / docume nts sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. B. Provisions of revised “Public Procurement” (Preference to make in India) order 2017 noti fied vide order no. P- 45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II) dated 19/07/2024 of Ministry of Commerce a nd Industry, Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) shall be applicable. Bidders seeking benefits under Purchase Preference to Make in India (linked with local cont ent) shall have to comply with the provisions specified under the revised Public Procuremen t (Preference to Make in India) order 2017. The salient features of which are as under: (a) Minimum local content: - The minimum local content shall be applicable as per latest Government guidelines.

(b) Margin of Purchase Preference: - The margin of purchase preference shall be 20%. (c) In the event of any Nodal Ministry prescribing higher or lower percentage of purchas e preference and/or local content in respect of this procurement, same shall be appl icable. The ‘Class-I local supplier’/’Class-II Local supplier’ at the time of tender, bidding or so licitation shall be required to indicate percentage of local content and provide self-certificati on that the item offered meets the local content requirement for ‘Class-I Local supplier’/’Cla ss-II Local supplier’, as the case may be. They shall also give details of the locations (s) at which the local value addition is made. In cases of procurement for a value in excess of Rs. 10 crores, the ‘Class-I local supplier sh all be required to provide a certificate from the statutory auditor or cost auditor of the comp any (in the case of companies) or from a practicing cost accountant or practicing chartered accountant (in respect of suppliers other than companies) giving the percentage of local co ntent. A supplier who has been debarred by any procuring entity for violation of this Order shall n ot be eligible for Purchase Preference under this Order for procurement by any other procu ring entity for the duration of the debarment. A self-certificate to the effect that the bidder has not been debarred by any procuring entity from violation of this order should be enclos ed along with techno-commercial bid. Concurrent application of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises Order, 2012 and Public Procurement (Preference to Make In India) Order. 2017 shall be as per Dep artment of Expenditure O.M. dtd. 18.05.2023. No relaxation against norms on prior experience & turnover for startups (recognized by DIP P)/Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) in Public Procurement subject to their meeting of qualit y and technical specifications. To avail such relaxation, party shall have to submit the relev ant certificate issued by concerned authority. C. MSME vendor payment through TREDs: MSME vendor Payment through TReDS: GoI has introduced electronic platform for facilitating the financing of trade receivables of MSMEs from buyers, through financers, which is termed as Trade Receivables Discounting S ystem (TReDS). NFL is already registered on RXIL/Invoice Mart/M1xchange TReDS platforms . MSME Bidders are requested to kindly register on the TReDS platforms and avail the TReDS facility, if they want to. The contact details are as below: TReDS Platform Contact Person Mobile e-mail RXIL Anurag Singh 7982459262 Anurag.singh@rxil.in INVOICE MART Yash Pal 9646511449 Yash.pal@invoicema rt.com M1xchange Shreyash Watile 7057527698 Shreyash.watile@m 1xchange.com

Bidders upon successful delivery shall submit their invoices along with the mandated enclo sures including TReDS details. Upon receipt and acceptance of the supplied material/servic es and receipt of invoices with the mandated enclosures, NFL shall process the invoice for p ayment as per details submitted on TReDS platform. Any unfinanced invoice/s of MSME bidders seeking payment from NFL directly shall be proc essed as per the Standard payment terms agreed in PO / contract. All financing cost for using the facility shall be borne by the MSME bidder only. D. Supplier/ vendor whose turnover exceeds Rs. 5.00 Crore in any financial year from 2017 -18, is required to issue E-Invoice as per the provision of Rule 48 of CGST Act, 2017. If the s upplier/ vendor fails to comply with the provision of Rule 48, such invoice will not be a valid invoice and the recipient/ buyer will not be entitled to claim the Input Tax Credit of GST pai d as per section 16(2)(a). You may kindly specify whether E-invoice provisions are applicabl e to you. E. Successful bidder shall provide their latest bank details (valid bank mandate/ cancelled c heque copy/on their letterhead, etc.) at the time of invoice submission. F. EMD (Earnest Money Deposit): Tenders must be accompanied by Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 1,00,000.00/- (Rupees One Lakh Only). EM D can be submitted through e-transfer in NFL account through RTGS/NEFT O R Bank Guarantee . Earnest M oney BG format shall be as specified on GEM for Bid Security /EMD. Cheques will not be accepted. The Ban k Guarantee must be directly sent to NFL by your Bank through regd, AD. NFL’s Bank Details: Bank Name: Bank of India A/C No: 675130100009001 IFSC Code: BKID0006751 Branch Name: Panipat Branch, Haryana-132103 EMD of successful tenderer shall be refunded after submission of SD cum PBG/ ePBG or ca n also be adjusted against SD cum PBG/ ePBG. G.PAYMENT: Our standard terms of payment is “100% within 30 days of receipt & acceptance of the mat erial at NFL Stores Panipat”. H. Security Deposit (SD) cum PBG/ ePBG

SD cum PBG/ e-PBG will be furnished by the successful tenderer, for faithful and proper fulf ilment of all T& C of the contract, within 15 days of award of contract. SD cum PBG/ ePBG w ill be @ 5 % of contract value. SD cum PBG/ ePBG can be submitted through e-transfer in N FL account through RTGS/NEFT. Cheques will not be accepted. The successful tenderer will, however, have the option to furnish a Bank Guarantee from a ny of the Schedu led Bank excluding Gramin/Co-operative Banks, in the Performa specified over GeM Portal for SD cum PBG / ePBG for the faithful and proper fulfilment of the contract . The SD cum PBG/ ePBG shall be valid for the d elivery period plus warranty period of 18 m onths plus claim period of 3 months. The Bank Guarantee must be directly sent to NFL by y our Bank through regd, AD I. II) IFN 767 COV for amendment of bank guarantee. III)Issuing bank shall mention IFSC Code as ICIC0000031 in field 7035 of IFN 760 COV/ IF N 767 COV. IV) Issuing bank shall mention NFL beneficiary code as “NFLNATIONAL04022015” in fiel d 7037of IFN 760 C OV / IFN 767 COV”. J. Adoption of ZED and LEAN Certification Schemes by MSME vendors: Gol has introduced following certification schemes for boosting the capabilities of MSMEs: a)MSME Sustainable, Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Certification Scheme (Silver/Gold level) : This scheme focuses on encouraging MSMEs to improve their manufacturing processes, re duce defects, enhance product quality and move towards sustainability through minimizing environmental impact. b)MSME Competitive, Lean Certification Scheme (Intermediate/Advanced Level): This sche me aims to enhance MSMEs productivity, efficiency, and competitiveness by reducing wast ages in processes, inventory management, Optimization of space, energy consumption, etc .
